text: {"assertions":["A bug in platform/config/loader.py involved wrong environment configuration affecting records with non-ASCII names.","The root cause was an error being swallowed by a bare except statement in the config loader.","The signal for this bug was a production endpoint appearing in a staging process.","The fix involved narrowing the exception handler to allow the failure to propagate, implemented in PR #2692 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1.","The bug could be reproduced by booting the service with an unset profile variable.","After the fix, the affected job completed in 29 minutes instead of 3 hours, representing a significant performance improvement."]}
